responsibility: Declares the simplify_using_ranges helper and related VRP utilities that consume range_query results to optimize GIMPLE. It provides the interface for range-based statement and condition simplification, loop-bound helpers, and type-fit predicates, separating the public range-driven transformation API from the implementation details in vr-values.cc.
same_name_distinction: Declares the simplify_using_ranges class and related entry points that vr-values.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file’s optimization logic, this header is the public interface for clients invoking range-based GIMPLE simplification.
